objective: Fix review findings F1-F3 from rev-muzjj8vq-01c8f7c9 for the notes API and add tests that would have caught them.
context: Review findings F1 (IDOR on GET /notes/:id), F2 (stack trace leak, 500 on malformed JSON), F3 (unbounded body, X-User placeholder).
expectedOutput: Patched src/server.js and new regression tests; all tests pass.
acceptanceCriteria: GET by id returns 404 for non-owners
Malformed JSON/invalid types return 400; unexpected errors return a generic 500 with no stack
completedWork: F1: GET /notes/:id now returns 404 when note.owner !== X-User, same as DELETE. F2: added HttpError and parseNote; invalid JSON gives 400 invalid_json, non-object or bad title/body gives 400 validation_error; the catch block returns a generic 500 and logs the stack server-side only. Also fixed DELETE 204 to send no body. F3: readBody caps at MAX_BODY_BYTES (default 1 MiB) and returns 413; X-User is documented in a code comment as a placeholder identity. Tests added in test/security.test.js: cross-user GET and DELETE, malformed JSON, type validation, generic 500, oversized body.
remainingIssues: X-User is still a spoofable placeholder identity; real authn is out of scope for this phase.
